Task bundles: [`counterexample`](https://github.com/conjectures-io/conjectures-tasks/tree/2a58149e6edb0f1dc15b32391f8c29fdd85e9db3/pool/tier-1/erdos-617-counterexample) · [`formalized`](https://github.com/conjectures-io/conjectures-tasks/tree/2a58149e6edb0f1dc15b32391f8c29fdd85e9db3/pool/tier-1/erdos-617-formalized)

> Let $r\geq 3$. If the edges of $K_{r^2+1}$ are $r$-coloured then there exist $r+1$ vertices with at least one colour missing on the edges of the induced $K_{r+1}$. In other words, there is no balanced colouring. A conjecture of Erdős and Gyárfás [ErGy99].
